_notes: Untrimmed source pixels of flashlight_fish_a1.png (768x512, local MOSS-Image cutout, so feather and overlap are about a third of the 2048-source species values). Peduncle alpha>128 profile: 47-49 px over x=232-256 (y 227-275); the caudal fin flares left of x=228 and the dorsal and anal fins start at x=264. The cut sits in that plain stalk. Fin polygon traces the dark pectoral fin; pivot is its root at the operculum. night (Anomalops katoptron, nightOnly): organ_px is the centre of the kidney-shaped light organ under the eye. tools/art/rig.py darkens the painted organ in the body layer inside an ellipse of radii darken_px (source px), so the organ reads as shut when the glow Poster is off, and writes glow.center (body-local display px, both facings) into the rig. components/Fish draws the glow Poster (uri at size display px, centred on glow.center, id starting with night so components/Night does not moonlight-tint it) and blinks it on one repeating Animation of blinkLoopSec seconds: lit spans of blinkOnSec, shut spans of blinkOffSec, fade blinkFadeSec, all drawn per fish from its blinkSeed (components/lib/glow.brs). nightOnly fish are invisible by day and fade in with the night level (m.global.nightLevel, set by components/Night).
